summary: Re-verified single bug fix from iteration_5 against http://localhost:8001 with admin@triveni.com. (1) The specific review case — POST /api/settings/service-tasks with body {"service_label":"TDS Filing 2"} and NO service_key — now returns HTTP 200 with the persisted document {id: sts_1795ee6696d1, service_key: "tds_filing_2" (auto-slugged from label), service_label: "TDS Filing 2", default_deadline_days:7, default_followup_days:3, auto_task_enabled:true}. Persistence confirmed via GET /api/settings/service-tasks; cleanup via DELETE returned HTTP 200 {"deleted":1}. (2) Full rerun of /app/backend/tests/test_auto_task_on_invoice.py — the same file exercised in iteration_5 — now shows 17/17 PASSED (0.40s), including the previously red test_label_only_post_ergonomics, with all 16 previously-green cases (TestTaskCustomerFields x3, TestServiceTasksCRUD x5 excluding ergonomics, TestAutoTaskToggle x3, TestAutoTaskHookOnInvoice x4, TestAutoTaskGuardRails x1) still green. Backend code inspected: server.py:497 now correctly declares `service_key: Optional[str] = None` on ServiceTaskSettingInput, letting the endpoint's existing `_slug(payload.service_key or payload.service_label)` handler derive the key from the label alone.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:497 ServiceTaskSettingInput.service_key is now Optional[str] = None — matches the endpoint's `key = _slug(payload.service_key or payload.service_label)` fallback logic at server.py:1964. Clean, minimal fix.
Verified auto-slug produces a URL-safe key from labels with spaces + digits: 'TDS Filing 2' -> 'tds_filing_2'. No regressions in duplicate-key detection (409) or in seed-defaults idempotency.
